hazard: The two larger magnets may detach posing choking and ingestion hazards. Magnets that are very small can be easily swallowed or inhaled. The magnets can then pinch together and create a blockage and slowly tear through the intestinal walls, causing perforations. The resulting injuries can be very serious and life-threatening. As of July 3, 2025, the company has received no reports of incidents or injuries in Canada. In the United States, the company has received 3 reports of the larger inside cover magnets detaching, and no reports of injuries. What you should do

Recalled units have 3 smaller and 2 larger magnets on the inside of the front removable device cover. Pura 4 models are identified as “Version Number: V4” on the label above the metal plug prongs. The affected Serial Numbers are JX230000001 to JX230801425 and JX240000001 to JX240049959. Issue

The 4 digits under the ETL certification indicate the month and year of the production. The date code 1117 would represent November 2017. title: Caldwell Rechargeable Battery compatible with Caldwell E-Max Pro BT Hearing Protection recalled due to burn hazard
body: Starting date: July 21, 2021 Posting date: July 21, 2021 Type of communication: Consumer Product Recall Subcategory: Electronics Source of recall: Health Canada Issue: Burn Hazard Audience: General Public Identification number: RA-75945 Last updated: 2021-07-21 Summary Product: Caldwell Rechargeable Battery compatible with Caldwell E-Max Pro BT Hearing Protection. Issue: The rechargeable battery pack can short circuit and overheat, posing a burn hazard to consumers. What to do: Consumers should immediately stop using the affected rechargeable battery and contact American Outdoor Brands Inc. for a free replacement battery pack. Affected products What you should do Joint recall with Health Canada, the United States Consumer Product Safety Commission (US CPSC) and American Outdoor Brands Inc. Affected products Caldwell Rechargeable Battery compatible with Caldwell E-Max Pro BT Hearing Protection Product description This recall involves the Caldwell Rechargeable Battery (model number 1108859). The affected battery is compatible with the Caldwell E-Max Pro BT hearing protection earmuffs (model number 1099596), used for dampening sound while shooting firearms. All Caldwell E-Max Pro BT hearing protection units contain the affected batteries. Only the battery is affected by the recall, not the hearing protection earmuffs. The battery is a 3.7V, 700mAh Li-Polymer battery measuring 3.175 centimeters (1.25 inches) x 3.75 centimeters (1.5 inches) x 1.25 centimeters (0.5 inches) and weighs 18.6 grams. Hazard identified In affected units, a soldering issue could allow the housing of the battery to become loose, causing the wire to short and conduct heat. This could result in possible shorting, bulging and overheating of the battery, posing a burn hazard to consumers. As of July 14, 2021 the company has received no reports of incidents or injuries in Canada or the United States. Number sold The company reported that 88 units of the affected product were sold in Canada and 2,086 units were sold in the United States. Time period sold The affected products were sold from January 2021 to May 2021. Place of origin Manufactured in China Companies Distributor American Outdoor Brands Inc. title: Char-Broil and Saber Grill and Grate Cleaners recalled due to lack of appropriate labelling and hazard information
body: Starting date: June 23, 2021 Posting date: June 23, 2021 Type of communication: Consumer Product Recall Subcategory: Chemicals Source of recall: Health Canada Issue: Product Safety Audience: General Public Identification number: RA-75881 Last updated: 2021-06-23 Summary Product: Char-Broil Grill Cleaner, Char-Broil Grate Cleaner, Saber Grate Cleaner, Saber Grill Cleaner & Polish. Issue: Products lack appropriate labelling and hazard information. What to do: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled products and dispose of the products in accordance with local municipal hazardous waste requirements. Affected products What you should do Affected products Char-Broil and Saber Grill and Grate Cleaners in pressurized containers Product description This recall involves Char-Broil Grill Cleaner (UPC 047362465580, 368 g), Char-Broil Grate Cleaner (UPC 047362663467, 482 g), Saber Grate Cleaner (UPC 099143900599, 482 g) and Saber Grill Cleaner & Polish (UPC 099143900575, 368 g). All products are packaged in pressurized containers. Hazard identified The recalled products do not have the proper hazard labelling as required by the Consumer Chemicals and Containers Regulations , 2001 under the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act . Improper labelling could result in unintentional exposure to the product and lead to serious illness, injury or death. As of June 10, 2021, the company has not received any reports of consumer incidents or injuries related to the use of these products in Canada. Number sold Approximately 13200 units of the affected products were sold in Canada. Time period sold The affected products were sold from May 2017 to June 2021. Place of origin Manufactured in USA Companies Manufacturer Char-Broil, LLC Columbus Georgia UNITED STATES Images (select thumbnail to enlarge - opens in a new window) What you should do Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled products and safely dispose of the products in accordance with local municipal hazardous waste requirements. body: Starting date: March 29, 2021 Posting date: March 29, 2021 Type of communication: Consumer Product Recall Subcategory: Chemicals Source of recall: Health Canada Issue: Chemical Hazard, Product Safety Audience: General Public Identification number: RA-75231 Last updated: 2021-03-29 Summary Product: Dans un Jardin Canne de NoÃ«l scented reed diffusers recalled due to lack of child-resistant packaging and aspiration hazard warnings. Issue: The products lack child-resistant packaging, and the packaging does not feature hazard warnings required in Canada. What to do: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled products, keep them out of reach of children, and contact Dans un Jardin for an exchange, store credit, or refund. Affected products What you should do Affected products Dans un Jardin Canne de NoÃ«l scented reed diffusers Product description This voluntary recall involves Dans un Jardin Canne de NoÃ«l scented reed diffusers sold in 100 mL glass bottles with a wooden cap. Product code: 251212 UPC: 630500660765 Hazard identified The recalled products do not meet the child-resistant packaging and labelling requirements for consumer chemicals set out in the Consumer Chemicals and Containers Regulations, 2001 under the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act . body: Starting date: December 21, 2020 Posting date: December 21, 2020 Type of communication: Consumer Product Recall Subcategory: Tools and Electrical Products Source of recall: Health Canada Issue: Electrical Hazard Audience: General Public Identification number: RA-74597 Last updated: 2020-12-21 Summary Product: iRobot Clean Base for Roomba Â® i7+ Robot Vacuum. Issue: If the robot ingests a significant volume of liquid, the circuit board may be exposed to liquids and short circuit. What to do: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled product and contact iRobot to obtain a free repair. Affected products What you should do Affected products iRobot Clean Base for Roomba Â® i7+ Robot Vacuum Product description The affected product is the automatic dirt disposal dock (the "Clean Base") for use with certain Roomba i7+ robot vacuums. title: B-Air and BlueDri Blower Fans recalled due to risk of fire hazard
body: Starting date: August 12, 2020 Posting date: August 12, 2020 Type of communication: Consumer Product Recall Subcategory: Tools and Electrical Products Source of recall: Health Canada Issue: Fire Hazard Audience: General Public Identification number: RA-73643 Last updated: 2020-08-12 Summary Product: Intertex LLC B-Air and BlueDri Blower Fans. Issue: The utility (convenience) outlets on the side of the blowers are not protected by a circuit breaker. If the outlet becomes overloaded or short-circuited, it could overheat, posing a fire hazard. What to do: Consumers should immediately stop using the convenience outlets on the side of the blowers and contact Intertex for a cordset adaptor with an integrated circuit breaker. Affected products What you should do Joint recall with Health Canada, the United States Consumer Product Safety Commission (US CPSC) and Intertex LLC. Affected products Intertex LLC B-Air and BlueDri Blower Fans Product description This recall involves several models of centrifugal and axial blowers sold under the B-Air, and BlueDri brands. Each blower has convenience outlets on the side of the unit to allow the blowers to be "daisy chained" (several blowers plugged together in series) or to allow other devices to be plugged in. title: LUS Hair Dryer and Diffuser recalled due to risk of electric shock
body: Starting date: April 23, 2020 Posting date: April 23, 2020 Type of communication: Consumer Product Recall Subcategory: Household Items Source of recall: Health Canada Issue: Product Safety Audience: General Public Identification number: RA-72845 Last updated: 2020-04-23 Summary Product: LUS Hair Dryer and Diffuser. Issue: The recalled product is marked as conforming to the standard UL 859; however, the product does not have an immersion protection plug, which poses a risk of electric shock in homes without Ground Fault Circuit Interrupters (GFCI) if immersed in water. What to do: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled product and contact LUS Distribution Inc. for disposal instructions and to obtain a full refund. Affected products What you should do Joint recall with Health Canada, the United States Consumer Product Safety Commission (US CPSC) and LUS Distribution Inc. Affected products LUS Hair Dryer and Diffuser Model HD-LUS01 Product description This recall involves the LUS Hair Dryer and Diffuser, model HC-LUS01. The hand-held 125 V/60 Hz hair dryer is white in colour and bears the logo "LUS Brands" and "Love Ur Curls". The dryer comes in two speed settings, "low" and "high", and three temperature settings: "cool", "warm", and "hot". Hazard identified The hair dryer and diffuser is marked as conforming to the standard UL 859 but the recalled product does not have an Appliance Leakage Current Interrupter (ALCI) plug, which poses a risk of electric shock in homes without Ground Fault Circuit Interrupters (GFCI) if the product becomes immersed in water. As of April 20, 2020, the company has received no reports of incidents or injuries in Canada or the United States. Number sold Approximately 410 units of the affected product were sold in Canada and approximately 3167 were sold in the United States. Time period sold The affected products were sold from November 2019 to February 2020. Place of origin Manufactured in China Companies Distributor LUS Distribution Inc. body: Starting date: December 5, 2019 Posting date: December 5, 2019 Type of communication: Consumer Product Recall Subcategory: Tools and Electrical Products Source of recall: Health Canada Issue: Product Safety Audience: General Public Identification number: RA-71824 Last updated: 2019-12-05 Summary Product: Pelican 9410 Industrial Flashlight and Pelican 9415 Industrial Flashlight. Issue: The battery pack of the flashlight may explode while charging, posing a risk of injury to consumers. What to do: Immediately stop using the flashlights and contact Pelican to arrange for the return of the unit for repair. Affected products What you should do Affected products Pelican 9410 Industrial Flashlight and Pelican 9415 Industrial Flashlight Product description This recall involves the Pelican 9410 Industrial Flashlight and the Pelican 9415 Industrial Flashlight. The Pelican 9410 is an LED lantern style, hand-held model that has 741 lumens, a battery pack comprised of four nickel metal hydride ("NiMH") rechargeable size C batteries, is 8.75" long, weighs about 3 pounds, has a sturdy handle and is sold with a charger. The body is made of ABS plastic and the lens is polycarbonate. The Pelican 9415 Industrial Flashlight (the "9415") is an LED lantern style, handheld model that has 588 lumens, a battery pack comprised of four NiMH rechargeable size C batteries, is 8.75" long, weighs about 3 pounds, has a sturdy handle and is sold with a charger. The 9415 is distinguished from the 9410 by the fact that it is safety-certified. Below are the affected Products: Description Colour Pelican 9410 Industrial Flashlight Yellow or Black Pelican 9415 Industrial Flashlight Yellow or Black Pelican 9410 Replacement Charger Black Pelican 9415 Replacement Charger Black Pelican 9410 Replacement Battery Black Pelican 9415 Replacement Battery Black Hazard identified The NiMh battery pack of the 9410 and 9415 Industrial Flashlight may explode while charging, posing a risk of injury to consumers and bystanders. As of December 4th, 2019 the company has received no reports of incidents or injuries in Canada. Number sold Approximately 1,425 units of the 9410 Industrial Flashlights and 854 units of the 9415 Industrial Flashlights were sold in Canada. Time period sold The 9410 Industrial Flashlights were sold from January 2010 to December 2013 whereas the 9415 Industrial Flashlights were sold from June 2013 to August 2019. Place of origin Manufactured in the United States Companies Distributor Pelican Products ULC 10221-184th Street T5S 2J4 Edmonton Alberta CANADA Manufacturer Pelican Products INC. 23215 Early Avenue Torrance, CA 90505 Torrance UNITED STATES Images (select thumbnail to enlarge - opens in a new window) What you should do Consumer should immediately stop using the affected products and contact Pelican to arrange for the return of the Units to Pelican for repair. body: Starting date: April 17, 2019 Posting date: April 17, 2019 Type of communication: Consumer Product Recall Subcategory: Tools and Electrical Products Source of recall: Health Canada Issue: Product Safety Audience: General Public Identification number: RA-69604 Last updated: 2019-04-17 Summary Product: Heat Hero Mini-Heater Issue: The heaters could overheat, posing a burn and fire hazard. What to do: Immediately stop using the recalled products and contact Heat Hero, LLC. for a replacement product. Affected products What you should do Joint recall with Health Canada, the United States Consumer Product Safety Commission (US CPSC) and Heat Hero, LLC Affected products Heat Hero Mini-Heater Product description This recall involves the Heat Hero Mini-Heater with the UPC code 8 6000085559387 . The 350W plug-in ceramic space heaters are black and measure about 10 inches (25 centimetres) tall and 5 inches (13 centimetres) wide. They have at the top an LED digital screen that displays the temperature and four control buttons, a front grill, a red on/off button on the right side and a vent on the bottom. The affected mini-heaters have a three prong plug on the back of the unit that cannot rotate. There is no brand mark on the unit. The control buttons of the unit are black with white writing. The Heat Hero logo and the UPC code are printed on the product packaging. Hazard identified The power switch in the product may overheat, posing a burn and fire hazard. As of April 8, 2018, the company has received no reports of incidents or injuries in Canada. In the United States, the company has received 117 reports of the heater overheating, including 47 units smoking and 10 catching on fire, two resulting in property damage. No injuries have been reported. Number sold Approximately 49 units of the affected product were sold in Canada and approximately 20,000 were sold in the United States. Inc. One report resulted in an explosion in Canada and the other resulted in minor fire damage in the United States. No injuries have been reported. title: Amazon recalls AmazonBasics Portable Power Banks
body: Starting date: March 21, 2018 Posting date: March 21, 2018 Type of communication: Consumer Product Recall Subcategory: Electronics Source of recall: Health Canada Issue: Burn Hazard, Fire Hazard Audience: General Public Identification number: RA-66230 Affected products What you should do Affected products AmazonBasics Portable Power Banks Product description This recall involves six versions of AmazonBasics' portable lithium-ion battery chargers/power banks. The rubberized or metallic power banks are black and rectangular. The AmazonBasics logo is printed on the front of the unit. Power banks with the following Product ID numbers are included in the recall: Product ID Number Description Size B00LRK8EVO AmazonBasics Portable Power Bank with Micro USB Cable - 2,000 mAh 3.86×2.44×0.28 inches (98×62×7.2 mm) B00LRK8HJ8 AmazonBasics Portable Power Bank with Micro USB Cable - 3,000 mAh 4.1×2.5×0.34 inches (103×64×8.6 mm) B00LRK8I7O AmazonBasics Portable Power Bank - 3,000 mAh 4.76×1.52×0.55 inches (121×38.6×14 mm) B00LRK8IV0 AmazonBasics Portable Power Bank - 5,600 mAh 4.57×2.59×0.53 inches (116×66×13.5 mm) B00LRK8JDC AmazonBasics Portable Power Bank - 10,000 mAh 5.63×2.83×0.65 inches (143×72×16.5 mm) B00ZQ4JQAA AmazonBasics Portable Power Bank - 16,100 mAh 5.89×3.23×0.77 inches (149.6×82×19.6 mm) The P roduct ID number can be found printed on the back of the unit. Hazard identified The power bank's battery can overheat and ignite, posing fire and burn hazards. As of March 14, 2018, the company has received no reports of consumer incidents or injuries related to the use of this product in Canada. In the United States, the company has received 53 reports of the power banks overheating, including one report of chemical burns due to contact with battery acid and four reports of property damage, including fire and smoke damage. Number sold Approximately 2 units of the affected products were sold in Canada and approximately 260,000 were sold in the United States. Time period sold The affected products were sold from December 2014 to July 2017 in the United States and shipped into Canada in August 2015 and November 2015. title: Whirlpool Corporation recalls KitchenAid Electric Kettles
body: Starting date: February 20, 2018 Posting date: February 20, 2018 Type of communication: Consumer Product Recall Subcategory: Household Items Source of recall: Health Canada Issue: Burn Hazard Audience: General Public Identification number: RA-65998 Affected products What you should do Joint recall with Health Canada, the United States Consumer Product Safety Commission (US CPSC), PROFECO and Whirlpool Corporation Affected products KitchenAid Electric Kettles Product description This recall involves KitchenAid 1.7 L Electric Kettles with a metal body and a plastic handle sold in various colours. The affected products can be identified by the combination of both the product model number and the product serial number. These numbers are located on the label on the bottom of the kettle and also on the bottom of the base. The following products are included in the recall: Model Number Colour Serial Number Range KEK1722SX Stainless YA325***** to YA724***** KEK1722ER Red YA325***** to YA724***** KEK1722OB Black YA325***** to YA724***** KEK1722WH White YA325***** to YA724***** KEK1722QG Liquid Graphite YA325***** to YA724***** RKEK1722SX Cocoa Silver YA325***** to YA724***** RKEK1722ER Red YA325***** to YA724***** RKEK1722OB Black YA325***** to YA724***** RKEK1722WH White YA325***** to YA724***** Hazard identified The handle on the kettle can loosen and separate from the body causing hot contents to spill, posing a burn hazard. As of January 23, 2018, the company has received 19 report of handle detachment in Canada, and 1 report of minor burn injuries. In the United States, the company has received 79 reports of handle detachment, and 3 reports of minor burn injuries. In Mexico, the company has not received any reports of handle detachment, nor injuries. Number sold Approximately 47,350 units of the affected products were sold in Canada, 40,200 in the United States, and 1,635 in Mexico. Time period sold The affected products were sold from September 2013 to February 2018 in Canada, from September 2013 to February 2018 in the United States, and from January 2016 to February 2018 in Mexico. title: Vornado Air LLC recalls Vornadobaby Sunny CS Nursery Heater
body: Starting date: January 31, 2018 Posting date: January 31, 2018 Type of communication: Consumer Product Recall Subcategory: Tools and Electrical Products Source of recall: Health Canada Issue: Burn Hazard, Fire Hazard Audience: General Public Identification number: RA-65766 Affected products What you should do Joint recall with Health Canada, the United States Consumer Product Safety Commission (US CPSC) and Vornado Air LLC Affected products Vornadobaby Sunny CS Nursery Heater Product description This recall involves Vornadobaby Sunny CS (Cribside Sensor) Nursery Heater with model number EH1-0090 manufactured in 2017. UPC 043765009147 is found on the bottom panel of the retail box The model number and serial number appear on a label under the cord wrap cover on the bottom of the heater. The serial number format is MMMYY-NNNNNN. It is composed of three letters for the month (MMM), two digits for the year of manufacture (YY), and a unique six digit sequence (NNNNNN). The recalled heaters MMM will be either AUG or SEP and the YY 17. Hazard identified The heat element may come in contact with inner plastic material, posing a fire or burn hazard. As of January 18, 2018, the company has received no reports of incidents or injury in Canada. In the United States, the company has received five reports of the units catching on fire within moments of first usage. There have been no injuries reported. Number sold Approximately 102 units of the affected products were sold in Canada through Amazon.ca, and approximately 3,900 units were sold in the United States. Time period sold The recalled products were sold from October 2017 to December 2017. Place of origin Manufactured in China. Companies Distributor Vornado Air, LLC Andover Kansas UNITED STATES Images (select thumbnail to enlarge - opens in a new window) What you should do Consumers should immediately stop using the product and contact their municipality for instructions on how to dispose of or recycle the recalled electrical product. For more information and to obtain a refund, consumers can contact Vornado by telephone toll-free at 1-844-205-7978 from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. CST Monday through Friday or visit the company's website to complete the recall steps. Vornado will request a photograph of the serial number located on a label under the cord wrap cover on the bottom of the heater. Canada Affected products Lithium-ion Batteries in HP Notebook Computers and Mobile Workstations that are not customer replaceable. Product description The recall involves certain lithium-ion batteries compatible with HP notebook computers and mobile workstations. title: Electric Baseboard and Electric Fan Heater Thermostats by Honeywell International Inc. recalled due to fire hazard
product: Electric Baseboard and Electric Fan Heater Thermostats
whatToDo: Consumers should immediately stop using the affected products and contact Honeywell for information on how to receive a free replacement thermostat for the T4700, CT1950 or CT1957 models.For more information, consumers may contact Honeywell's Consumer Hotline toll-free at 1-888-235-7363 or visit https://www.resideo.com/us/en/recall/.Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada.Health Canada would like to remind Canadians to report any health or safety incidents related to the use of this product or any other consumer product or cosmetic by filling out the Consumer Product Incident Report Form.This recall is also posted on the OECD Global Portal on Product Recalls website. You can visit this site for more information on other international consumer product recalls.
hazard: The thermostat contains a line voltage relay which is used to switch the power to the electric baseboard heater or electric fan heater. The line voltage relay may not function properly and cause the plastic to overheat. Health Canada has not received any reports of incidents or injuries related to the use of these thermostats. What you should do
background: Number sold Approximately 240,837 units of the affected products were sold at various retail and trade outlets across Canada. Time period sold The affected products were sold from 2000 to 2007. Place of origin Manufactured in Singapore. Details Original published date: 2021-08-26
